detail.longDescription: Welp I have had it up to hear with # docker . What miserable # software . Runs as # root by default out of the box. Because, hey, nothing bad happens when you run everything as root. Was an absolute nightmare to setup # rootless . Can't get # forgejo runner to work cause # docker -compose doesn't properly set the directory owner for volumes. Then I have to figure how to get Forgejo to pull local custom Docker images. I just wanted an easy self hosted # ci -runner. Why does this have to be so harrrrrrdddd.
